S5 closed: 18 worker nodes across nova and imas-ambix (two-worker cap held throughout). Geometry corrections, solve-input maps, and the full vacuum-floor ladder executed; the ladder closed on its honest-failure branch (+0.023 sigma above the incumbent, qualified cutover status stands) with the gap decomposed onto six channels at 91-253x their measured noise floors. The acquisition-scale discovery (19 stepping channels) and the committed artifact-arm bench path are the sprint's durable infrastructure gains.

S6 'Close the P4/P5 misfit source' proposed: flux-loop calibration, toroidal-harmonic misfit maps, P4/P5 provenance. Grounded in the new source-localization record (first misfit maps; differential-circuit hypothesis excluded as recorded superposition; description asymmetry and disjoint P4 loop sets surfaced by the data survey).

S6 widened with four infrastructure plans: diagnostic-correction-schema, nova-calibrate-package, vacuum-signature-extraction, coil-geometry-inversion. Grounding: Edlington 2001 retrieved in-repo (analogue integrators; 180-degree pair summing before integration; cans galvanically tied to vessel via supports and feeder-bar bellows); traced polygon Green's kernel verified autograd-able w.r.t. coil geometry (values 8e-12, jacfwd at the FD floor, jacrev consistent 1e-12).

S6 started (Session A of two): diagnostic-correction-schema implementation and the P4/P5 symmetry-elimination scan dispatched as the first two-worker wave; nova-calibrate-package migration and the coil-geometry-inversion kernel autograd audit queued behind them; read-path equivalence with constant deletion and provenance geometry/pack-total work queued third. Flux loops, toroidal harmonics, vacuum-signature extraction and inversion beyond the kernel audit are Session B.

S6 Session A executed: 8 worker nodes, two-worker cap held, all commits merged to main. diagnostic-correction-schema SHIPPED (LinkML schema + generated models + MAST instance; read-path cutover proven by 3395 float-equal reads before four constants and the 4394-line JSON table were deleted; promoted gains held OUT of the arithmetic, test-pinned). nova-calibrate-package first slice (5 of 9 capabilities, arrays-only kernels, synthetic-truth lane, banked pins). coil-geometry-inversion kernel audit landed: eight kernel classes geometry-traceable with three-part autograd regressions; two elliptic derivative repairs (forward-mode NaN; Carlson degenerate slope 3e-9 to 3e-15). mast-p4p5-circuit-provenance: symmetry verdict = geometry error EXCLUDED (at least 85 percent of surviving power needs current the coils do not carry; 23-cell lattice removes 15 percent on P5-lower; 5-turn row resolves to described side); provenance adjudicated - the 17.3 mm asymmetry was a closed-ring vertex-mean artifact, centroids consistent with as-built per Kirk Table 1, NO correction warranted; FL_P4L loop positions found to be a bit-copy of FL_P3L (feeds flux-loop calibration); pack-total identity confirmed at 4578 pairs and stated as mechanism (six channels explained, serving needs a two-channel source-map row - owner call). Evidence backfill: all eleven landed records carry plan-evidence-for. Records: mast-p4p5-symmetry-verdict, mast-p4p5-provenance-note, calibration-foundations-landed (all docs/research/*.html). Session B remains: flux loops, toroidal harmonics, vacuum-signature extraction, inversion geometry solve, p4p5 feeder hunt.

Owner decisions locked from the library/read-path audits: ambix provider split by tier (JAX owns the spine, latent physics-by-content migrates onto it, torch confined to the ML training tier — no thin-wrapper layer); nova biot response is a hygiene sweep with NO backend switch (numerics already single-source via the xp namespace; new plan nova-jax-hygiene); the five promoted gains ENTER the applied chain behind a single-door corrected reader (new plan mast-corrected-read-layer added to S6, blocks mast-catalog-gpu-solve); §4 artifact wiring proceeds with packaged pinned digest + env override, machine selection first.

Spine-proof gate inserted ahead of the GPU catalog on owner direction. Nova owns all physics solves: the differentiable boundary-push capability maturing in ambix ports into nova (ambix batched-newton-accelerator superseded by nova spine-boundary-accelerator), and an EFIT-comparable assembled-chain reconstruction (spine-efit-parity, firewalled efm referee) must pass before the catalog run. New sprint S7 carries both plans; the catalog item moved from the S4 slot to S8 to keep the sprint sequence dependency-consistent. Port audit banked as boundary-push-port-audit: kernel byte-identical, 43 behaviour tests and both accelerators unported, hex stencil machinery already native to nova.

S9 'Transport forward model' created: flux-function-forward-transport promotes the transport solve to a public Nova capability beside ForwardProfile — TORAX-embedded fidelity ladder over the landed current-diffusion rung, FSA geometry adapter, COCOS boundary tests, coupled equilibrium–transport loop. Grounded in transport-forward-contract (capability-gap inventory; embed verdict; the TORAX imas-python==2.1.0 pin is the gate). The flux-function seam plans in both repos were extended to cover transport authority in the same session.
